name: Reynah Dioquino
source:
Kinesiology & Health Sciences Major, Year 2

The elusive, yet reliable president of the Student Government. A social butterfly and a busy, busy bee, she's responsible for almost every event on and around campus. But, for all her cheerful hospitality, underestimate her at your own peril: Reynah Dioquino is never caught off-guard.

[From [url=https://blank-house.itch.io/keyframes]itch.io[/url]]
